messages:
ryan: Quick postmortem follow-up from last night's cross-region egress instability. Intermittent TLS handshakes + routing flaps caused ~15% retry amplification for EU->US paths. Need owners/timelines for remediation and runbook updates. Please ack and add ETA.

sarah: Ack. I'll own the routing rule investigation and a safe rollback plan. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

kai: I'll take the TLS handshake regression investigation. Running cert chain checks and SNI probes across regions. ETA: 48h.

mike: I'll own LB autoscale & traffic shaping review. Propose a canary route and burst-limit tweak. ETA: Mon.

anita: Can someone add an alert for cross-region TLS handshake failures to PD? I can create once thresholds are agreed.

ryan: @anita pls add after thresholds decided. Proposed threshold: >5% handshake failures across region for 10m.

lee: Noted correlation with egress NAT IP churn in pool-2. Pulling connection logs now. Quick query I'm running:
```sql
SELECT minute, count(*) as errs FROM requests
WHERE tls_error IS NOT NULL AND src_region='eu'
GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 20;
```

ops-shadow: Incident INC-4921 updated: owners assigned (sarah / kai / mike). :gear:

kai: Triage note: seeing SNI mismatch on a subset of connections when traffic hits us-west egress pool-2 (certsync race suspected). Plan: add SNI header validation and push updated certs to pool-2. Rolling patch target: Wed 02:00 UTC.

sarah: Temporary mitigation: pin eu->us egress to pool-1 as a canary. Command I'll run with deploy team: `routeset egress.pin=pool-1 --scope eu-us --duration 2h` — will coordinate window.

mike: For canary, shard 1% of traffic with header `x-rw-canary: egress-stable` then escalate to 10%. I'll also add metric `egress.retry_rate_by_pool` to the console.

ryan: Add this to the PM playbook: root cause = egress pool churn + cert sync timing mismatch causing SNI failures. @anita please own the playbook update. ETA: Fri COB.

anita: Ack — updating runbook to include detection query, rollback commands, and contact matrix. Will include sample `routeset` and `curl` checks.

lee: Scheduling follow-up sync Thurs 15:00 UTC to review telemetry after canary. Calendar invite sent.

ryan: Summary of owners: routing = sarah, tls = kai, autoscale = mike, alerts + playbook = anita, data = lee. I'll close this thread when INC-4921 has the tasks and playbook PR is merged. Thanks :thumbsup:

sarah: leaving notes in INC-4921 with the exact commands and backup rollback steps.

kai: posting probe results to the incident ticket once batch finishes.

mike: will start the metric dashboard widget tomorrow morning.

anita: PR opened for playbook updates, requesting review.

ryan: Great. If anything slips, call the Thurs sync earlier. Otherwise we'll confirm post-canary health then close action items. :eyes:
